w10_T4_003631: Sara's warehouse receives a delivery of 3 trucks, each carrying 7 pallets with 33 boxes on every pallet, which is more boxes than the 500 that Tim's warehouse receives that day. A van then drops off 39 extra boxes, and 5 more are found on the loading dock. Each box weighs 9 kilograms. The wooden pallets that go on the scale with the boxes add 66 kilograms. Sara records the total in tonnes, since a thousand kilograms make one tonne. How many kilograms are on the scale?
w10_T4_003634: The wood shed behind Petra's cabin held 74 logs at the start of December. She burned 29 logs in the first cold week, then 10 logs the next week, and 22 logs over the holidays. A neighbour delivered 72 logs to the shed in January. In the following week Petra burned 21 more logs. How many logs are in the shed now?
w10_T4_003639: Nico had 150 trading cards, more than the 120 cards his friend Pia had. He won 15 cards in a tournament. He then traded away 148 cards for a rare set. Pia gave him 5 cards as a birthday present, and he lost 4 cards on the bus. How many trading cards does Nico have now?
w10_T4_003642: Ola's cooking channel had 240 followers. A popular chef mentioned the channel and its follower count doubled. Then 24 of Ola's classmates followed her. A second shout-out doubled the follower count again, and 5 relatives joined. Her newest video is 3 minutes long. When that video went viral, the follower count grew to 5 times what it had been. How many followers does Ola's channel have now?
w10_T4_003646: In the morning, the cash tin at Ravi's tea stall held 121 rupees, more than the 100 rupees in Meena's tin at the stall beside his. During the morning Ravi added 35 rupees from early customers. In the afternoon he put in 59 rupees from lunch orders and then 36 rupees from a group of tourists. In the evening his uncle matched everything in the tin rupee for rupee, doubling it. How many rupees are in Ravi's tin now?
w10_T4_003647: An art school ordered 162 crayon kits at 4 dollars each. It handed 98 kits to the junior class and 16 kits to the senior class. Each of the kits still in the cupboard contains 3 pouches, and each pouch holds 9 crayons. The cupboard also holds 77 loose crayons in a tin and 15 loose crayons in a drawer. How many crayons are in the cupboard?
w10_T4_003655: In the morning, Ola's prepaid phone showed 43 minutes of talk time, on a phone that cost 200 dollars. She used 16 minutes calling her mother and then received 13 bonus minutes from the network. In the afternoon she used 11 minutes on a work call. In the evening she used 6 minutes chatting with a friend. The network lists its plans in hours, and Ola knows that sixty minutes make one hour, but she tracks her balance in minutes. How many minutes of talk time does Ola have left?
w10_T4_003656: Lars's printing press prints 90 pages every minute, faster than Mia's press, which prints 60 pages a minute. Lars runs the press for 8 minutes on each job, completes 6 jobs in every hour, works 6 hours a day, and finishes a contract in 4 days. He divides the whole stack of pages equally between 2 clients, and the Oak Publishing share is then divided equally among its 5 branches. How many pages does Oak Publishing's Harbour branch receive?
w10_T4_003661: Nina's year group has 67 pupils, more than the 60 pupils in Omar's year group. On sports day 5 of Nina's pupils are absent. Each pupil present is given 3 sheets of stickers, and each sheet holds 6 stickers. Nina also has 6 spare stickers in her pocket. The stickers are priced in cents but the invoice is written in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many stickers does Nina hand out and keep spare in total?
w10_T4_003664: In the morning, Leo's ferry left the harbour with 189 passengers, more than the 150 on Ana's ferry. At the first island 186 passengers got off, and 1 more got off at the lighthouse jetty. In the afternoon 32 passengers boarded for the return trip. Every passenger on the return trip paid 6 tokens, and Leo spent 76 tokens on fuel. In the evening he exchanged his remaining tokens at the harbour office, which pays 3 dollars for each token. How many dollars did Leo receive?
w10_T4_003665: In the morning, the station car park held 144 cars. Before lunch 5 more cars arrived. In the afternoon 37 cars arrived for a concert, and 19 cars left. In the evening 112 cars drove out. How many cars are in the car park now?
w10_T4_003667: In the morning, Ken picked 196 strawberries, more than the 150 that Yuki picked in the same field, which covers 2 hectares. Before lunch he picked 67 more. In the afternoon he added another 10 strawberries and then divided all his strawberries equally among 3 baskets, taking only 1 basket home. In the evening he ate 87 strawberries from his basket. How many strawberries are left in Ken's basket?
w10_T4_003669: In the morning, 148 spectators had gathered on the beach for the kite festival. Before lunch 25 more arrived, and then a coach brought 50. In the afternoon the crowd grew to 4 times its size as the main display began. In the evening, when the illuminated kites went up, the crowd grew to 8 times its afternoon size. How many spectators were on the beach in the evening?
w10_T4_003671: In the morning, Ivy had 15 dollars in her purse, and her aunt gave her 7 dollars. She spent 9 dollars on a book before lunch. In the afternoon she spent 12 dollars on a cinema ticket. In the evening her brother offered to match whatever was in her purse and gave her exactly that, doubling it. Then her grandmother gave her 59 dollars. How many dollars does Ivy have now?
w10_T4_003676: In the morning, the school's roof fund was counted: each of 4 collection tins held 197 dollars, and all of it went into the fund. Before lunch the fund paid 600 dollars for roof tiles. In the afternoon the fund paid 151 dollars for a builder's visit. In the evening a former pupil promised to add enough money to make the fund 5 times as large as it then was, and she paid at once. How many dollars are in the roof fund now?
w10_T4_003678: A charity store received 152 donated blankets, and it opens twice a week. It gave 130 blankets to a shelter, 20 to a hospital, and 1 to a passer-by. A hotel then donated 42 blankets. The store paid a laundry 7 dollars to clean each blanket it now had. How many dollars did the store pay the laundry?
w10_T4_003680: In the morning, 7 pallets of floor tiles arrived at a building site, with 179 tiles on each pallet. Before lunch a van brought 37 more tiles, and in the afternoon another 30 tiles were delivered. During the afternoon 184 tiles were broken and thrown away. The floor to be tiled measures 60 square metres. In the evening the tiler laid every remaining tile and charged 8 dollars for each tile laid. How many dollars did the tiler charge?
w10_T4_003682: Dev's irrigation pump moves 66 litres of water every minute, more than Priya's pump, which moves 50 litres a minute. Dev runs his pump for 9 minutes in each cycle, does 5 cycles every hour, and runs it for 9 hours, sending all the water into a reservoir. The reservoir's water is then piped out in equal shares to 5 field tanks. The north field tank loses 942 litres to evaporation, and a rain shower adds 31 litres to it. Dev logs the tank levels in litres although the gauges read in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres are in the north field tank now?
w10_T4_003683: In the morning, the warehouse at a fruit market held 236 crates of apples, and by noon a delivery had tripled the number of crates. In the afternoon 8 more crates arrived from a small orchard, followed by 59 crates from a larger one. In the evening a final lorry brought another 59 crates. How many crates of apples are in the warehouse now?
w10_T4_003684: In the morning, a tanker delivered 7 barrels of cider to the harvest festival, each barrel holding 217 litres, and half of the barrels were oak. Before lunch a farmer added 43 litres from his own press. In the afternoon 551 litres were served to visitors. In the evening 247 litres more were served. The organisers log the cider in litres even though the supplier bills in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of cider are left?
w10_T4_003686: Ela has 74 dollars in her savings tin, more than the 70 dollars her cousin Bo has saved. She adds 34 dollars from her birthday. She takes out 52 dollars for a concert ticket and then 50 dollars for a pair of boots. Her aunt then promises to top up the tin until it holds 6 times as much as it does, and she does so. Ela counts her coins in cents but records her savings in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars are in Ela's tin now?
w10_T4_003690: A biology student counts 56 bacterial colonies on a dish and adds 27 more colonies from a second dish. The incubator is kept at 37 degrees. Overnight, each colony on the dish grows into 9 colonies. The next day 545 colonies die after a dose of antibiotic. Over the following night each surviving colony splits into 6 colonies. How many colonies are on the dish now?
w10_T4_003694: A tailor had 211 metres of ribbon in her workshop, and a dozen apprentices worked there. She used 129 metres for wedding dresses and 69 metres for hats. She cut each remaining metre of ribbon into 7 equal strips. Of these strips, 41 were spoiled by a stain. From each good strip she made 9 small bows, and she already had 17 bows in a box. How many bows does the tailor have?
w10_T4_003696: In the morning, the Red Fox team scored 63 points at each of the 9 stations of a scavenger hunt. Before lunch the judges took away 125 points for a rule breach. In the afternoon the team earned 67 points on a bonus puzzle. In the evening's final challenge, the team's score was multiplied by 8, and then the team received 75 points for finishing first. How many points did the Red Fox team finish with?
w10_T4_003702: Tom logs his violin practice in minutes. His daily routine is 29 minutes of scales, and this week he adds 14 minutes of sight-reading to every daily session. He practises this routine on each of 6 days. He also does an extra 17 minutes before his lesson and 49 minutes at an orchestra rehearsal. His teacher asks for the total in hours, and Tom knows that sixty minutes make one hour, but he writes his total in minutes. How many minutes does Tom log this week?
